Song projects

Live loops

Free / drop plays immediately with no BPM. Tempo sync follows the beat. Choose Once or Loop for each clip.

Drag audio onto a slot or press Load. Files without a BPM tag start in Free / drop, Once. Pitch changes speed too; Reset pitch restores the original. Tempo sync uses the bars setting. Number keys 1–8 fire the loops, and so do the pads in Loops pad mode.

Sampler

No sample loaded
Drag a sample from Tracklib (or any audio file) onto Beatdeck, or press Load sample.
Chop by

Drag IN / OUT at the top of the waveform to fade the selected chop. The original audio stays unchanged.

Load a sample to edit a chop. Hold and Loop playback stop when you release a keyboard key.

Tape changes speed with pitch. Stretch keeps tempo and pitch independent.

Export audio

Saves the beat as a WAV file you can drop into a DJ set, a radio show or other music software. It's cut to the exact loop length, so it repeats cleanly.

How many times through

Steps set to less than 100% chance get a fresh roll on every pass, just like playback. Muted lanes stay silent.

Hardware controller

Not connected

Beatdeck connects to the Maschine by itself when it opens. If the Maschine isn't in MIDI mode yet, press Get Maschine ready: Beatdeck opens the Maschine software out of sight, you hold Shift and press Control, tap a pad, and Beatdeck closes the Maschine software for you.

Pad mode

Alesis Vortex Wireless

8 pads for drums, keyboard for sample chops, and Up/Down beside Start/Stop for lane selection.

M-Audio Code 25

16 pads work like the Maschine pads. Piano keys play sample chops.

Buttons and knobs

Maschine MK2 preset: Play/Rec, the first four screen buttons for pad modes, and knobs 1–5 for tempo, swing, human feel, master volume and lane volume. Use knob Page 1.

Live-screen test is off. Use Beatdeck Live for text, or the original Beatdeck template for labels and level bars.

Pad page E matches the current Controller Editor setup. Select the same pad page here and on the MK2.

Press Assign, then press a button or turn a knob on your controller. Assignments are kept in this browser.

Whole song · all bars and tracks
Select a section Select a section to set its length.
Select a recorded event to move or remove it

Record Pattern writes into the selected beat. Record Song captures a performance over this arrangement, then stops after one pass. Every song bar has its own cells. Duplicate section creates an independent copy. Click any bar to edit just that bar. Press Save to keep your song.

Space plays or stops. Click a lane's name to select it. Cut puts lanes in a group where each hit cuts off the others, like a closed hi-hat choking an open one. The four Chops tracks each hold a separate sample. Select a Chops lane or use the Sampler track selector; the keyboard plays that track. For its grid: pick a slice (click it on the waveform or hit its pad), then click steps to place it. Patterns A–H can hold 1, 2, 4 or 8 bars. The grid shows one bar at a time. Use + Add and the song arrangement to build sections. Record Song captures a performance over one pass of that arrangement. Number keys 1–8 fire live loops. Samples, kits and loops you load are kept on this Mac, so they're here next time you open Beatdeck. Press Save to keep your patterns and song.
